cards.name: The Fool
cards.essence: The already-defeated one who walks anyway — off the board, unnumbered, going again regardless of what the previous journeys cost.
cards.question: Which Fool is speaking? The Reckless one who mistakes returning energy for recovery, or the Whimsical one you've been trained to ignore?

unities.superpower: Lofty ideals, lifelong curiosity
unities.trap: Body-blind; the drag back to material reality lands as shock

unities.superpower: Creative wand, the entertainer's instrument
unities.trap: Cane covering the injuries of every previous start

unities.superpower: Beginner's mind, the capacity to go again
unities.trap: Failure to integrate; starting from zero every time

unities.superpower: The satirist's real office, licence to say the unsayable
unities.trap: Public exposure when the mask fails

unities.superpower: Radical trust, absence of defensive cynicism
unities.trap: The Fool is also the one who can be fooled

cards.name: The Magician
cards.essence: The dazzling kid who's found the one place the world claps for a brain like theirs — and has spread every tool they own out on the table to prove it.
cards.question: Are you performing your intelligence because you love it, or because you've learned it's the only thing that gets you loved?

unities.anchor: The table full of tools and objects
unities.superpower: Genuine mastery — light-years ahead in the things you've chosen, and the joy of showing off what you know is real and infectious
unities.trap: The tools become props in a performance rather than instruments of curiosity

unities.superpower: A shameless, delighted belief in your own brilliance — rare, and worth protecting
unities.trap: The identity fuses to being 'the clever one,' and curiosity gets replaced by the need to be seen as smart

unities.anchor: The hidden shyness under the showman's posture
unities.superpower: A rich, private inner world that the performance is only the visible tip of
unities.trap: Crushing self-doubt living in the same body as the swagger, at the same time, unresolved

cards.name: La Papesse
cards.icon:
CROWN + VINES
ON A CLOSED BOOK
cards.essence: The one who found a whole universe inside her books and stopped needing the one outside — and honestly, why would she leave, when in here everything finally makes sense.
cards.question: Is the room peaceful because you're safe in it, or because you've stopped believing anywhere else could be?

unities.anchor: The vivid, detailed crown against the plain backdrop
unities.superpower: Total immersion — grokking a subject completely, building a rich internal world nobody else has access to
unities.trap: The internal world becomes so much richer than the external one that reality stops looking worth the trip

unities.anchor: The books, the robed and covered figure
unities.superpower: Deep-dive learning: fast, complete, genuinely joyful absorption in a subject
unities.trap: A permanent research phase — perpetually preparing, never finishing, never bringing anything back out

unities.superpower: Restfulness — a nervous system that has finally found somewhere it doesn't have to defend itself
unities.trap: Cloistering as a permanent address instead of a place to visit

cards.name: The Empress
cards.essence: The one who came alive after dark — fearless, magnetic, and finally, blessedly, unbothered by what anyone thinks of her.
cards.question: Is this power yours yet, or are you still just holding something enormous you haven't learned to carry?

unities.superpower: Fearless directness that reads to everyone in the room as confidence — because it is confidence, no permission required
unities.trap: The same all-in intensity that makes her magnetic doesn't know when to stop

unities.superpower: Enormous creative and sexual power, alive and growing
unities.trap: Power not yet integrated — easier to be swept up by than to steer

unities.superpower: The inversion: a world running on stamina, sensation and nerve instead of daytime rules, where she finally has the advantage
unities.trap: A total absence of the shame mechanism others have internalised, which reads as fearlessness but leaves no built-in brakes

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.essence: The confident, put-together man everyone gets measured against — proof, mostly, of how much of 'normal' was never built with you in mind.
cards.question: Whose template are you trying to fit, and did anyone actually check it was built for a body like yours?

unities.anchor: The grey hair, the full control
unities.superpower: A genuinely useful mirror — naming him clearly is the first step to no longer absorbing him unconsciously
unities.trap: You can name the whole game and still lose to it, because the daytime world is built in his image regardless

unities.superpower: He shows you exactly what 'arrived' is supposed to look like, which is genuinely useful information
unities.trap: Believing you should look like that in order to have arrived at all

unities.anchor: His stillness — he doesn't need to notice you to shape you
unities.superpower: Once you see his power doesn't require your participation, you can stop performing for an audience that was never watching
unities.trap: He's patient — waiting quietly through every clever workaround you think you've found

cards.name: Le Pape
cards.essence: The system that finally explained everything — and the sheer relief, for a pattern-hungry brain, of a cosmology that actually adds up.
cards.question: Did you find the truth, or did you find the first system rigid enough to feel like one?

unities.superpower: The genuine gift of total commitment — understanding a framework deeply enough to live inside its logic completely
unities.trap: Certainty mistaken for truth; not noticing when the framework you found is just another cage shaped like an answer

unities.anchor: The audience, the urge to share
unities.superpower: If it's true, sharing it isn't dogmatism — it's generosity, and the urge to spread relief is a kind thing
unities.trap: Not everyone is looking for the same complete system; urgency tips into missionary certainty

unities.superpower: Finding rules that finally make internal sense, after years of rules that didn't, is real peace, hard-won
unities.trap: Mistaking a system that tells you what's wrong with the world for one that tells you what's wrong with you

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.essence: The moment the self meets the other — and finds out, against a lifetime of being told otherwise, that its people were out there all along.
cards.question: Are you loving with your whole depth, or building a fortress around one person and calling it love?

unities.anchor: The two flanking figures pulling at the central one
unities.superpower: An almost supernatural ability to find your people — even undiagnosed, even against the odds, your kind finds your kind
unities.trap: Getting pulled between competing versions of who you 'should' be before you've worked out which voice is actually yours

unities.superpower: When you love, you love completely — deep, loyal, and rarer than most people ever get to experience
unities.trap: The same completeness tips into fusing your whole identity to one person, and losing yourself in the process

unities.anchor: The figure still gazing at the mother while being claimed by the partner
unities.superpower: Real emotional intensity and an enormous capacity for closeness
unities.trap: Confusing the fantasy you've fixated on for the obvious, real signal standing right in front of you

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.icon:
ORNATE WHEEL,
SMALL CROWN ON TOP
cards.essence: Three coffees in, firing on all cylinders, building something extraordinary while the rest of the world wonders how on earth you did it.
cards.question: Is this flow, or is this the fire you'll spend three days recovering from?

unities.superpower: Feeling fully defended and certain — ready to build, ready to argue for what you're making, unstoppable in the moment
unities.trap: The armour also stops anyone, including you, from noticing the cost building up underneath it

unities.superpower: The chosen-one feeling of a real flow state — brain moving fast, building huge complex patterns other brains can't touch
unities.trap: The chariot isn't actually moving forward the way it looks; sprinting hard doesn't always mean travelling anywhere

unities.anchor: The smiling and sad faces on the shoulders
unities.superpower: A theatrical, larger-than-life relationship with your own story — you get to be the hero
unities.trap: The flip side of epic hero is epic failure, and there's rarely a middle setting

cards.name: Justice
cards.essence: The one who cannot let an unfair thing lie — because an open loop, once you've spotted the unfairness in it, does not close itself.
cards.question: Is this clarity serving the world, or is being right quietly becoming more important than being loved?

unities.superpower: A sharp, rapid ability to map how systems empower some people and disempower others — genuinely useful, genuinely rare
unities.trap: The same sharpness turned inward becomes a verdict on yourself: proof you're part of the machine you're angry at

unities.superpower: A real, principled refusal to look away from unfairness
unities.trap: Losing interest in things — school, work, whole institutions — the moment you decide the game is rigged

unities.superpower: Conviction — once you've found your position, you hold it
unities.trap: Holding it so hard it costs you the relationship, when being understood would have served you better than being right

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.essence: The one who's been through it, come out the other side with a lantern full of hard-won knowledge, and gone looking for someone to hand it to.
cards.question: Are you resting, or have you quietly decided the cave is safer than ever coming back out?

unities.superpower: Wisdom worth sharing — the wounded healer, turning your own hard road into something that lights someone else's
unities.trap: Solitude prescribed as the cure can tip into isolation prescribed as the whole identity

unities.superpower: You've survived the damage and you're still walking, knowledge intact
unities.trap: The injuries are real, and moving slowly doesn't mean they're healed

unities.superpower: Recognising when your social battery needs recharging, and being unapologetic about taking it
unities.trap: For the ADHD half of you, too much alone time doesn't recharge — it just gets lonely, quietly, without you clocking it

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.essence: Licking your wounds just long enough before the itch to spin the wheel again gets too loud to ignore.
cards.question: Is the thrill of the spin calling you forward, or are you spinning because sitting still has started to feel unbearable?

unities.superpower: A genuine love of the game — the moment of adventure that makes you feel most alive, most switched-on, least alienated
unities.trap: Crisis-seeking as a way of life; loving change so much you manufacture it even when things were fine

unities.anchor: The figures riding up and down
unities.superpower: ADHD wired for exactly this: thriving in change, extremes, high stakes
unities.trap: Autistic terror of the same unpredictability, pulling in the opposite direction at the same time

unities.superpower: The willingness to get back in the game after a real loss — real resilience, not denial
unities.trap: Never spinning at all — staying in the Hermit's cave because the wheel feels too dangerous to touch

cards.name: Force
cards.essence: The quiet, staggering strength it takes just to run a brain like this — invisible to everyone who's never had to do it.
cards.question: Do you know how much internal labour you do every single day, or has it become so automatic you've stopped counting it as strength at all?

unities.anchor: The calm face holding open the lion's mouth
unities.superpower: An enormous, largely invisible daily strength — the sheer self-monitoring and regulation it takes to function, done without flinching
unities.trap: Because it's invisible, nobody else clocks the cost either — including you, until you crash

unities.superpower: The power to channel raw, unruly energy — sexual, creative, whatever form it takes — into something directed and useful
unities.trap: The refining takes real effort every time; it never becomes fully automatic no matter how practised you get

unities.superpower: You know, better than most, that the internal work matters and has to be done
unities.trap: Believing it's entirely on you to fix, alone, in the dark, without help

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.essence: Upside down by choice, waiting for the rope to break in its own time — not stuck, exactly, more like paused on purpose.
cards.question: Have you actually accepted being here, or are you performing acceptance while quietly furious you're still stuck?

unities.superpower: A body finding its own rhythm even in stillness — a kind of stimming, a kind of self-regulation
unities.trap: The stillness can be mistaken, by you and everyone else, for having no forward motion at all

unities.anchor: The hands tied behind the back
unities.superpower: Sometimes surrender really is the move — accepting you can't force the next step and letting it come
unities.trap: Time blindness means the same loop repeats without you noticing you've been here before

unities.superpower: Growth still happening, even upside-down, even in the dark
unities.trap: Pretending you're not stuck at all, and refusing to do the deep work that would actually free you

cards.name: Death
cards.essence: Standing in the ruins of a chapter that's ending, grieving hard — and somewhere underneath the wreckage, already compost for what grows next.
cards.question: What are you refusing to cut away, and what would it cost you to keep it?

unities.superpower: Reinvention — deliberately building a new version of yourself for the next phase of life, done consciously, again and again
unities.trap: You spend real time wallowing in the black stuff before anything grows from it, and there's no shortcut through that part

unities.superpower: Even consciousness itself can be composted and regrown into something better
unities.trap: We grieve longer and harder than most, and letting go, when it's time, is genuinely one of the hardest things we do

unities.superpower: Real, decisive editing — cutting away what's not working instead of endlessly adding to it
unities.trap: Reversed, this becomes refusing to simplify, refusing to let anything go, scope-creeping your own life

cards.name: Temperance
cards.essence: The angel who's learned, slowly and with real effort, how to let two different states of you flow into each other instead of crashing between them.
cards.question: Are you managing your energy, or just white-knuckling until the next crash?

unities.anchor: The two jugs pouring into each other
unities.superpower: Learning to move deliberately between nervous system states — upshifting, downshifting, on purpose rather than by accident
unities.trap: It takes real, constant, unglamorous effort; it never becomes fully automatic

unities.superpower: A sustainable flow instead of a sprint — the version of productivity that doesn't cost three recovery days afterward
unities.trap: Sustainable is quieter and less thrilling than the Chariot's rush, and can feel like giving something up

unities.superpower: The decaf-coffee wisdom — small, unglamorous choices that protect you from your own excesses
unities.trap: Easy to override in the moment when the Chariot's charge feels so much more exciting

cards.name: The Devil
cards.essence: The one cast as the monster for refusing hierarchies that were never built to include you — creative, uncanny, and completely unbothered by being called wrong.
cards.question: Is this rebellion building something, or is it revenge dressed up as freedom?

unities.superpower: A carnal, whole embodiment of both — desire and identity refusing to be split down a line someone else drew
unities.trap: Being cast as evil or dangerous just for existing outside the lines can curdle into believing it yourself

unities.superpower: Deep creative material lives in the parts of yourself that scare you, and going there is genuinely valuable work
unities.trap: The same subconscious force that creates can also destroy, including turning on yourself

unities.superpower: Gleeful, genuine love of things 'normal' people hate — real joy in your own strange taste, no apology
unities.trap: Sometimes the impulse isn't joy at all — it's exhaustion with masking curdling into a pure desire to burn it all down

cards.name: The Tower
cards.essence: The old self-image finally blown apart — painful, sudden, and the only reason the trapped energy underneath ever gets to move again.
cards.question: What system just collapsed, and what does it free you to build instead?

unities.superpower: Hitting real ground is disorienting, but it's also the first honest information you've had in a long time
unities.trap: The fall genuinely hurts, and recovery takes real time you can't rush

unities.anchor: The balls of colour raining down
unities.superpower: Energy that was trapped in a system that wasn't serving you, finally released and available to use
unities.trap: Release isn't gentle — it comes as catastrophe first, usefulness later

unities.superpower: Sometimes the only way to get unstuck is for the whole structure to come down at once
unities.trap: You don't get to choose the timing, and it rarely happens on a day you were ready for it

cards.name: The Star
cards.icon:
EIGHT-POINTED STAR
OVER A POURING JUG
cards.essence: A rare, earned moment of peace after the underworld — someone stroking your hair, telling you you've been very brave, and for once, you believe it.
cards.question: Can you let yourself rest here, or does part of you think peace has to be justified first?

unities.anchor: Emptying the jugs into the river
unities.superpower: Individual water joining collective water — your healing becoming part of something bigger than just you
unities.trap: The peace is real but it's rare; the scanning brain doesn't stay quiet for long

unities.superpower: For a meaning-hungry brain, this is the moment the veil rolls back and the universe's pattern becomes visible, whole, and kind
unities.trap: You can't manufacture this moment on demand, no matter how much you want to

unities.anchor: The new growth in the background
unities.superpower: Proof that healing is actually happening, visibly, after everything you've been through
unities.trap: Easy to mistake one good night under the stars for having arrived, rather than one stop along the way

cards.name: The Moon
cards.icon:
CRESCENT MOON OVER
A RISING CRUSTACEAN
cards.essence: The secret school hidden after dark, where the softer, stranger, more unmasked version of you finally gets to come out and play.
cards.question: Is the night giving you rest, or somewhere to hide from a daytime you've given up on?

unities.superpower: Deep self-knowledge, right down to the oldest, least-verbal parts of the nervous system
unities.trap: Some of what lives down there is genuinely hard to look at, and staying under too long has its own cost

unities.superpower: The mammalian brain's own wisdom, softer and more intuitive than the daytime analytical mind
unities.trap: The trap here is quiet and honest: forgetting to come back and live in the real world at all

unities.superpower: Moon child energy — a little fey, a little of the night, reclaimed as something to be proud of rather than pathologised
unities.trap: The reduced demands of night-time are real relief, but they're not a substitute for daytime life

cards.name: The Sun
cards.essence: Staggering back out into the light after the underworld, wobbly, glowed-up, and unmistakably alive.
cards.question: What did you bring back with you, and are you ready to actually share it?

unities.anchor: The two figures, one steadier than the other
unities.superpower: Survivor joy — the exact, specific rush of powers coming back that you weren't sure would ever return
unities.trap: One side of you still struggles while the other cheers it on; recovery isn't even across the whole system at once

unities.superpower: You made it out of the underworld and it shows — you've had a glow-up, and you've earned every bit of it
unities.trap: Still a little wobbly on your feet; the recovery is real but not yet complete

unities.anchor: The warmth of the sun itself
unities.superpower: This is the reason you come back to reality at all — good days, real people, new understanding worth sharing
unities.trap: It would be easy to stay in the soft underworld forever; the Sun is the pull back that some part of you resists

cards.name: Judgement
cards.essence: The trumpet call for the thing you dragged back from the underworld — proof the internal work was never just for you.
cards.question: Is what you're bringing back part of something bigger, or is it still just for you?

unities.superpower: Our need to find new things in the dark and bring them into the light is a genuine, valuable creative force — oppressed communities innovate because they have to
unities.trap: You can make the whole underworld journey and still come back empty-handed; it's not entirely in your control

unities.superpower: What gets born from this work is genuinely new — not expected, something the world hasn't seen before
unities.trap: Something that strange and new can be hard for anyone, including you, to recognise as valuable at first

unities.superpower: The internal work finding an external, corporeal form — actually launching the thing rather than just discovering it
unities.trap: It only completes if something bigger than you meets it halfway; you can't force the contract alone

cards.name: The World
cards.icon:
OPEN OVAL WREATH,
RIBBON SPINNING INSIDE
cards.essence: The whole journey held at once — every part of you, all four forces balanced, dancing at the centre of something genuinely, gorgeously whole.
cards.question: Can you hold the whole of what you are as one thing worth celebrating, rather than a set of parts to manage?

unities.anchor: The four figures in the corners — angel, eagle, lion, ox
unities.superpower: Every part of you — compassion, intellect, creative and sexual power, material stability — present and balanced at once
unities.trap: Believing you need to keep them in perfect balance permanently, rather than letting them naturally take turns

unities.superpower: Total, unapologetic creative and erotic power, worth celebrating rather than hiding
unities.trap: A meaning-saturated universe is euphoric, but the pattern-hungry brain can just as easily flip into believing nothing means anything at all

unities.superpower: Bottom-up thinking's real gift — building up to the epic scale from the ground, rather than failing to see the big picture at all
unities.trap: The scale of this vision can make ordinary daily life feel small and disappointing by comparison
